create.title: New room
create.description: A room is one conversation for several people and company socios. Each message runs as the person who sent it; nobody’s private memories or data are shared.
create.name: Name
create.lead-hint: Company socios only. A room admin can ask for more later.
create.lead-hint_none: There is no company socio yet: ask an admin to add one.
create.more-hint: Each starts as a request a workspace admin approves.
create.people-hint: You are a member and admin already. Invited people get an invite to accept.
create.purpose-hint: Shown to the room’s members. What is this room for?
create.purpose-placeholder: What this room is for, in a sentence or two

convert.title: Share this chat as a room?
convert.description: “{{title}}” becomes a room you are the admin of, with the same link and history. You can then invite people.
convert.done: This chat is now a room. Invite people from Members.
convert.failed: Could not make it a room.
convert.confirm: I understand: everyone I invite reads this whole chat.

rename.title: Rename room
rename.description: Everyone in the room sees the new name.
rename.name: Name

leave.title: Leave “{{title}}”?
leave.description: You stop reading the room and it leaves your sidebar. An admin can invite you again.
leave.description_stuck: You are the only person in this room. Archive it instead: it is kept, and you can bring it back.
leave.description_handover: A room always keeps an admin. Choose who takes the role on: you leave once they have it.

invites.title: Room invitations
invites.description: Join to read and write in a room, or decline. Nobody sees the room’s messages before they join.
invites.invited_admin: You were invited as an admin

topic.name: topic #{{id}}
topic.title: Telegram topic
topic.description: In a linked forum topic, room members talk to the room’s socio by mentioning the bot or replying to it. It answers no one else.
topic.linked: Linked to {{topic}} in the Telegram group, <date></date>.
topic.linked_by: Linked to {{topic}} in the Telegram group by {{name}}, <date></date>.
topic.ended: Not linked. It was linked to {{topic}} until <date></date>.
topic.not-linked: Not linked to a Telegram topic.
topic.unavailable: Telegram isn’t connected on this server.
topic.link-account: Link your Telegram account first: choose Telegram in the sidebar. The code works only from your account.
topic.understood: I understand who reads the topic.
topic.no-username: A Telegram account without a username
topic.seen-hint: People with a linked account who wrote in the group and aren’t in the room. They join only if they accept.
topic.now-linked: The Telegram topic is linked to this room.
topic.read-failed: Could not read the room’s topic.

steps.send: In the Telegram topic, from your linked account and as an admin of the group, send:
steps.copy-failed: Could not copy. Select the command instead.
steps.expires: It works once, until <time></time>. The bot (@{{bot}}) answers in the topic.

convert-topic.title: Make this topic a room?
convert-topic.description: A new room you are the admin of, with this topic’s socio, linked to the Telegram topic.
convert-topic.code-description: The room appears under Rooms once the bot confirms it in the topic. Then invite people from its Members. This transcript stays as it is, for the people who can read it now.
